name: knot-sync-monorepo
description: Normalize legacy enterprise data (office files, scanned papers, old databases) for AI agents via MCP.

scripts.pack:cli: pnpm bundle:cli && node scripts/with-cli-publish-manifest.mjs npm pack
scripts.publish:cli: pnpm bundle:cli && node scripts/with-cli-publish-manifest.mjs npm publish --access public
scripts.scan:sample: pnpm build && node packages/cli/dist/bin.js scan --config examples/sample.config.yaml
